The burly driver roared loudly, rolling up his sleeves as if preparing for a fight.
"What happened?"
A voice came from inside the van, sounding somewhat impatient.
"Boss, someone rear-ended our car. I'm arguing with her. I looked at it, and even the bumper is dented. Boss, how much do you think we should ask her for compensation?"
The burly driver asked the man in the van respectfully, bowing slightly, seemingly quite restrained.

"Heh, the bumper, huh? Call the traffic police. Whatever the price, that's what you'll pay. Go negotiate with the repair shop based on their quote. If they refuse to pay, then settle it officially. Notify a lawyer and have them prepare for a lawsuit."
The man rolled up his window, seemingly unwilling to say more.
"Yes, boss."

After receiving the reply, the burly driver turned to Li Mingying arrogantly and said, "Our boss's car is an imported BMW. You damaged the bumper. Replacing the bumper and the repair costs will be 300,000 yuan. Do you want to settle this officially or privately?"

This was robbery!

Here, turning vehicles must yield to oncoming traffic, so she was fully responsible.

The more expensive the vehicle, the more expensive the repairs, so this price wasn't extortion.

Li Mingying couldn't let her daughter down, no matter what.

Even close relatives need to keep clear accounts.
There's no way to say who's right or wrong in this situation.
After all, money is involved, so things have to be clear.

But once this process began, Li Mingying knew it would definitely affect her daughter's future; her plans to study abroad or take postgraduate entrance exams would certainly be impacted.

chapters.title: Chapter 1221 Deceiving mature female teachers
paragraphs: Zhao An narrowed his eyes, scrutinizing Li Mingying. She was voluptuous; even inside her bra, her breasts were almost spilling out, making her blouse bulge.
Her face was lightly made up, and a deep sorrow lingered on her fair complexion.
Fine crow's feet lined the corners of her eyes, deepening with her grief, giving her a pitiful appearance.

"Teacher is quite beautiful; no wonder he was attracted to her. But although that guy is lecherous, he wouldn't dare to do anything rash. Now that you've hit his car, it's probably not something that can be easily negotiated. He said 300,000 was for a private settlement. If you had given him 300,000 directly, things might not be so complicated."
"Ah!" Li Mingying felt a surge of shame and anger when Zhao An looked her over, but after hearing his analysis, her face turned pale with fright. "Then, what should we do?"
Zhao An waved his hand, took a sip of water, and said, "Don't worry, worrying won't help. I'm 90% confident..." "You're being watched."
"Cheng Kai may be a scoundrel, but he's backed by the Liutian Group. The higher-ups in that group are all lecherous and don't get along with me."
"I own a modeling and acting agency. This industry is rife with unspoken rules, and I've ordered them to avoid being subjected to them, so they hardly ever get commercial performances."
"I can guarantee that the teacher's information has already been sent over there, so today is a trap!"
"Ah! Then, what should we do?!"
Li Mingying was increasingly confused. She didn't know what to say, her head spinning.
She had seen news reports about actors being subjected to unspoken rules.
But they always seemed to fizzle out. She never expected to be targeted!

Zhao An sipped his mineral water, his eyes flickering. "The Liutian Group is incredibly powerful. To be honest, I won't provoke them unless absolutely necessary. Those people are all despicable bastards. If it were anyone else, I'd just watch the show. But since it's you, teacher, as your student, I can't just watch you walk into the lion's den."
"Waaah, it's my fault."
Li Mingying listened to Zhao An's words, feeling there was no chance left.
Offending someone meant they definitely wouldn't help her; why was she so unlucky?
"Teacher, now is not the time to cry.
If you agree to their demands, even your daughter might not escape their clutches. That's not good news.
Do you think you'll still have the ability to resist after being filmed having sex?
Or would you still disregard your reputation for your daughter?
I think it's very difficult. Either way, it's hard to handle, and the outcome won't be good."
Zhao An analyzed meticulously, but it was really just intimidation.
Li Mingying was just a school teacher, a music teacher at that; what skills could she possibly have?
Compared to Li Cui back then, she was just the same.
However, compared to Lin Cui, Li Mingying's situation was much better; she had a car and a house.
Although they were old and worn, at least they were still usable, and she had some dignity.
"Teacher, why don't you come to my dorm for a bit? I need to have a smoke and think about it. I'll make a call first to buy you some time; I'd better save face."
Zhao An extended an invitation, then took out his phone and made the call.
He had planned all of this, so he wasn't in a hurry at all.
Besides, he wouldn't threaten Li Mingying; instead, he'd make her throw herself at him. Heh, he'd enjoy the feeling of using scheming to make a mature female teacher his devoted subject!
Bai Junlin and Lin Cui were discussing the issue, and only after a long while did they stretch their necks to avoid becoming too stiff.
"I'm going on maternity leave next month, so I'll be leaving things in your care then."
"I know, you've made all the plans. I'll just follow them."

Lin Cui said with a smile, glancing at Bai Junlin's large pregnant belly. She realized she was in the same boat as Bai Junlin—both had been defiled by Zhao An, both had gotten pregnant by him, both were pitiful women!
Bai Junlin nodded, trusting Lin Cui's abilities. "Have you been in contact with your son lately?"
Lin Cui shook her head. "I only sent him some money, nothing else. My husband doesn't like him, so I rarely contact him."
It wasn't that she didn't love her son, but she knew she couldn't interfere too much, otherwise she would beg her husband to find their son a good job, which would anger him.
Besides, she also had a daughter to take care of. She and her younger husband had a child together; taking care of her daughter was enough. She shouldn't think about anything else.
Bai Junlin nodded. "You did the right thing. I still have a lot to learn from you. By the way, where's your husband?"
"Him? He's probably talking to Li Mingying. He's never been honest. Li Mingying's probably in trouble."
Lin Cui's lips curled into a seductive smile.
You see, her little husband has been looking at the list of teachers at the school lately, plotting something.
Not just any woman can catch Zhao An's eye; he'll definitely find something interesting and easy to get.
So, those who aren't married, or whose husbands aren't teachers at the school, are in trouble!
Meanwhile, Li Mingying, half-asleep, followed Zhao An to the dormitory.
Upon entering, she saw many high-tech devices; the air conditioner was on, evacuating and changing the air.

Zhao An lit a cigarette, sat on the sofa, and poured Li Mingying a glass of water. "To be honest, I don't really want to mess with someone like that. There's not enough benefit for me, so I won't clash with him."
Li Mingying looked at Zhao An with a hint of fear in her eyes, not understanding why he said that. If that was the case, wasn't she being played?

Zhao An flicked his cigarette ash, a smile playing on his lips. "However, I have a connection with you, teacher, and we seem to have taken a liking to each other, so I don't mind helping you out of this predicament.
The power of capital is terrifying. To deal with capital, you can only fight it with capital. Isn't there a saying?
Only magic can defeat magic!"
Li Mingying suddenly wanted to laugh. That made a lot of sense. Zhao An's words eased her anxiety slightly.
"So, Zhao An, how do you plan to help me?"
"Have you heard that saying, teacher?" Zhao An smiled.
"What did you say?"
Li Mingying was puzzled; she had no idea what Zhao An was talking about.
"One should not covet a friend's wife."
Zhao An laughed heartily, his smile carrying a meaningful undertone!

chapters.title: Chapter 1222 An ungrateful woman
paragraphs: Li Mingying's pretty face flushed crimson instantly, a mixture of embarrassment and anger. Discussing such a topic with a student was genuinely awkward.
If it were someone her own age, she might joke about it, but Zhao An was her student; it was definitely embarrassing.
How could a teacher and student discuss such a topic?
"You, I," Li Mingying lowered her head shyly, unsure how to answer this student. It was just too shameful.
Looking at the bashful mature woman...
Zhao An's smile grew even brighter. "Even a friend's wife or other woman is off-limits. Although I'm not afraid of him, he wouldn't dare mess with me. Everyone has powerful backers."
Li Mingying looked up, her eyes wide with surprise. "Classmate, what do you mean?"
She seemed to understand, and frowned slightly.

Zhao An exhaled a puff of smoke, picked up his phone, and replied to a text message: "It's nothing. I just want the teacher to pretend to be my woman. I'll treat them to a meal, and you'll come with me. That way, they'll know you're my woman and won't bother you.

If the teacher doesn't want to, I don't have any good ideas. Forcibly interfering in your affairs won't do me any good. Besides, the investigation shows it's the teacher's fault—you rear-ended someone. This is a really difficult situation to handle, and I don't have any other options."
Li Mingying's face flushed slightly upon hearing this, looking somewhat unwell.
"Can I borrow money from that classmate? I promise I'll pay you back!"

Zhao An glanced at Li Mingying, then shook his head. "Alright, since that's the case, I can't help you. To be honest, he already has leverage over you. They've noticed you, and it'll be hard for you to defend yourself against both open and covert attacks. Fine, I know you can't get over this. Okay, I'll lend it to you, but you need an IOU. I'll have someone go with you and have the IOU notarized. There should be interest; anyway, if you can't repay the debt in E, you can use the house as collateral."
He then picked up the phone and called his lawyer, asking the firm to send someone to the traffic police station with Li Mingying.
"Thank you."
Li Mingying felt a little embarrassed. She had refused Zhao An's request, yet he was still willing to help her.
She had initially thought he wanted to sleep with her, but it turned out he didn't?
This made her feel ashamed; perhaps he genuinely wanted to help her.
"No need to be polite, I won't see you off. Goodbye."
Zhao An waved his hand, feigning generosity.
Watching Li Mingying's retreating, shapely figure...
Zhao An's smile grew increasingly playful. What a fool! Did she think this would solve everything?
When Li Mingying went to the repair shop to make the necessary compensation, the quote was 600,000 yuan, no exaggeration.
Because BMW parts are imported...
And it was also the market price.

It required sheet metal work, soldering, repairs, etc. The higher the price, the higher the maintenance costs. There were also labor costs for the vehicle being unusable due to repairs, etc., adding up to 600,000 yuan without a problem.
After looking at the compensation list, Li Mingying swayed unsteadily, almost fainting.
Gritting her teeth, she paid 300,000 yuan upfront, and then tried to raise another 300,000 yuan within a few days.
Looking at the driver's smirk, Li Mingying wanted to slap him twice.
But that won't do!
Meanwhile...
Zhao An was still looking at Li Mingying's daughter's information. She was already a junior and had already started an internship.
University students need to get internships as soon as possible, the sooner the better. Freshmen and sophomores focus on learning professional knowledge; juniors can start interning.
Because all knowledge originates from and returns to practice, it must be put into practice to test what has been learned.
Internships generally include metalworking internships for university students and internships arranged by companies for employees.
Companies' rigid requirements often become stumbling blocks for interns to be retained.
Internships, as the name suggests, are learning through practice.
After a period of study, or when studies come to a close, we need to understand how our learning needs or should be applied in practice.
Entering the first semester of senior year, the fall recruitment season will soon begin, the golden period for graduating students to find jobs.
During this period, prestigious companies gather, and campus recruitment events are constant. Many of these companies, once missed, are difficult to join as a recent graduate.
This is typical of university life, and it's inevitable. Since the goal is to prepare for graduate school, a good internship is a significant advantage.
After all, studying is ultimately about earning money; rote learning is pointless.

Generally, it's best to start an internship in the first semester of your junior year. Many companies recruit summer interns during the spring semester, and unlike regular internships, summer internships offer a higher chance of conversion to full-time positions...
Meanwhile, the fall recruitment season begins in the second semester of your junior year.
Having a summer internship provides a safety net, offering a backup plan if you secure a full-time position during the fall recruitment season.

If you intern in your senior year, it's essentially a combination of regular internships and spring recruitment preparation, significantly increasing the difficulty. Also, the quality and quantity of positions available in spring recruitment are far less than in fall recruitment, making the competition much fiercer.
Li Mingying, being a teacher, naturally understands this and will definitely encourage her daughter to get an internship as soon as possible.
Seeing this...
Zhao An picked up the phone and dialed. Killing someone is difficult.
But causing trouble for someone is a piece of cake.
Yang Xiaolin was still typing and processing documents at the company, chatting and laughing with her colleagues, seemingly quickly integrating into the environment.
She was also confident about the future, believing she could find a good job and not worry her mother.

The sound of high heels clicking on the floor came from behind her. A plump woman wearing glasses threw down the documents in her hand, put her hands on her hips, and scolded, "Yang Xiaolin, your report is wrong, causing the company to lose in negotiations. You entered the wrong numbers, preventing the business department from closing the deal. You have seriously violated work discipline and company regulations.
I'm sorry, you are fired. We will write the reason on your resume and send it to your school.
Now, you can pack your things and leave. Go to the finance department to settle your salary later!"
Boom! Yang Xiaolin was stunned. Before she could react, the HR manager was gone.
Her colleagues around her booed. Everyone knew that was the boss's sister, and it was difficult to persuade her.

It wants our school to select two teachers to teach in remote mountain villages for a period of time."
Bai Junlin showed the file directly to Zhao An.
It wasn't about whether it was legal or not; it was about giving men a new path.
Going out and causing trouble for other women was better than staying at school and having affairs with women close at home.
More than thirty female students had gotten pregnant and were on leave for maternity leave.
Even she would find this a bit of a headache.
Fortunately, it could be smoothed over; it wasn't a big deal.
If she got all the average girls in school pregnant, she'd really be in trouble.
Zhao An glanced at the document, his expression somewhat strange.
"I'll go then.
It'll be a good opportunity to start a business over there.
Manufacturing is always fundamental.
I don't deal with finance anyway, so I might as well do something good."
Zhao An wasn't just talking nonsense.
Some mountain villages are very remote; even his grandmother's village only got a road built a few years ago.
Before, it was all dirt roads.
Walking home on rainy days, your feet would be covered in mud that you couldn't wash off.
It's said that to get rich, you must first build roads.
With roads, you can attract outside investment, and local specialties can be sold.
But everyone wants to build roads.
But they can only choose to do it.
For no other reason than:
They don't have the money.
Young people have all gone to the big cities; there are hardly any people left in the villages.
Everyone needs to eat.
If it weren't for survival, who would willingly leave their hometown?
Bai Junlin looked surprised.
"Honey, if you go, what will we do?"
Zhao An laughed heartily and pulled Bai Junlin into his arms, inhaling the scent of her hair.
"Wife, I need to go for a walk.
Otherwise, if I stay here any longer, the whole school will probably become my harem."
Bai Junlin covered her mouth and giggled, "Okay, you're my husband, you decide."
She knew this was actually quite good.
Because Zhao An often hunted for women at hospitals or companies, using those women to help him out, and occasionally he'd sleep with celebrities and singers.
Moreover, Zhao An didn't like using condoms, preferred internal ejaculation, and wouldn't allow women to take any medication, only fertility drugs.
Plus, his semen quality was excellent, almost guaranteeing pregnancy with every encounter; a few times internal ejaculation would result in impotence.
Regarding getting women pregnant...
Zhao An seemed to have a very strong obsession with it.
If he didn't get a woman pregnant, what was the difference between that and prostitution?
What's more, the thought of having another man's wife bear his child is incredibly exciting!
Zhao An had no choice.
In the past two years, he'd slept with almost every woman he could get his hands on.
Now, it seemed like the women had all conspired to get pregnant, leaving him with no women to sleep with.
The women at the company were also heavily pregnant, having to work and provide Zhao An with sexual pleasure—it was quite a hardship.
After making up his mind, Zhao An began to act.
Passing by the music classroom, he peeked inside.
He saw Li Mingying wearing a maternity dress, her belly already showing a prominent curve.
She had become pregnant a month after her affair with Zhao An.
Her daughter, Yang Xiaolin, was only a few days later; mother and daughter were both pregnant with Zhao An's child!
Seeing a mature female teacher pregnant with their child teaching, the students below had no idea that their goddess teacher was merely a bitch under their crotch!
They were both students, yet they were still in an era where they couldn't earn money and could only spend it...
Zhao An, on the other hand, was already financially independent and could freely indulge in playing with beautiful women—that was the difference!
After returning home, Zhao An told his mother, who was pregnant again, about his plans.
Zhao Xinlei didn't insist that her son stay.
She simply nodded, "Be careful on your journey.
How long will you be gone this time?"
"Three months or half a year, I guess.
I'm not going there to relax.
I'm going to set up some factories and lease some land.
Developing some real businesses—with these industries in hand, we won't need to worry about market fluctuations; we can always keep making money."
Zhao An spoke with great confidence, and he truly was that confident.

chapters.title: Chapter 1245 Xiahe Village
paragraphs: True to his word, three days later...
Zhao An boarded a train to a mountain village.
It was deep in the mountains.
Because it was surrounded by mountains, there wasn't much development potential.
Developers are profit-driven; they won't go where there's no profit to be made. Therefore, the poor areas remained poor, with no chance of change.
Sitting on the train...
This time, Zhao An didn't bring anyone with him, leaving his women to handle things alone.
He also wanted to observe whether he was there or not; it made a difference.
If any woman dared to have any ulterior motives, he would truly turn her into a sex slave.
She would only be given the fate of being a tool for satisfying his desires and for procreation; even shopping and watching TV would be a luxury.
"Hey Zhao An, you're being a bit unfair. Where have you been making your fortune this time?"
Bai Qingyang's voice was as cheerful as ever. He was in high spirits, having already taken control of most of the Bai family's businesses.
And his cooperation with Zhao An was going very smoothly.
Zhao An rarely participated in management; he only provided ideas and oversaw finances, waiting for his share of the profits.
Even Bai Qingyang rarely encountered such a partner; he truly had no interest in power whatsoever.

However, it was impossible to dilute his shares and sideline him. It wasn't that no one could, but rather that no one could control their greed. If they wanted one dollar, they'd want two—an insatiable greed.
Therefore, people like Zhao An were rare and precious.
Zhao An sat in the private room, smoking a cigarette and sipping wine by the window. "Nothing.
Just going to wander around the mountain village, enjoy the scenery, and maybe find some inspiration."
"Haha, alright. If you need anything, just let me know."
Bai Qingyang simply smiled. The man was a genius, having designed many patents and acting eccentrically, with only one weakness: women.
He didn't care that his wife, Wen Lian, had been taken by a concubine; women were nothing to him.
On the contrary, he would continue to find women to send over.
Even if the other party had that kind of taste, he would satisfy them.
However, Wen Lian recently revealed that Zhao An seemed to have feelings for his mother.
The higher the status, the more easily a man's desire to conquer is aroused.
Bai Qingyang was somewhat annoyed; his mother was a beauty.
And his own mother at that—send her to Zhao An to have sex with?
He wasn't capable of going that far, but if Zhao An actively seduced her, he would at most turn a blind eye.
"Of course I'll tell you if there's a problem, but take it easy. Now isn't the time to deal with your father, so calmly hone your skills for two or three years."
Zhao An didn't say much.
He merely offered a hint.
To say he was bold and audacious was that he only wanted to have sex with Bai Qingyang's mother; to him, Bai Qingyang's mother was also his mother-in-law.
After all, Bai Qiuqin was his woman, the woman who had given him a beautiful daughter.
This didn't seem like much; it was just raping his mother-in-law, something he'd done before.
Bai Qingyang's eyes flickered slightly. "I understand. That's all for now. Tell me if you need anything. We're good friends, right?"
"Of course, very good friends. I cherish friends like you."
Zhao An hung up the phone with a loud laugh...
Looking out the window, a cold smile curled at the corner of his lips.

In the face of the financial crisis, the paths of powerful families are becoming increasingly narrow. How foolish! Low-profit industries aren't unacceptable, but once growth slows, the blow is devastating, and various conflicts will be triggered.
This is a train that can't be stopped. Once it stops, many hidden problems will be exposed.
If Zhao An were in charge, he would definitely first rip out all the rotting tumors on his own body.
Although it would severely damage his vitality, it wouldn't be fatal.

Doing it himself is always better than having someone else do it, but whether he understands it or not isn't up to him, and it's none of his business. Even if he's unlucky, he'll still live a good life.
The reason he went to be a volunteer teacher was twofold: firstly, to enhance his own reputation, and secondly, to hide away and avoid being approached by those family scions trying to curry favor.

It's been half a year, and the financial winter has only just begun. These families with tied-up funds are desperately needing a business to fill the gaps, and Zhao An is clearly a good option, so they'll definitely come to curry favor.
Two days later, Xiahe Village.
Zhao An arrived here with a few bags. It's almost deep in the mountains, and the road leading there is full of potholes, barely passable as a road, just enough for a car to drive through.
Each trip shortens a car's lifespan by a year.
Ordinary people have to traverse mountains to reach the village; building a road here is too expensive.
Without blasting the mountain to build a road, one has to wind around the steep slopes, wasting a lot of time.
And it's also very dangerous. For Zhao An, nothing was different; he could get there with just a few bags.
He declined any offer of a ride and, with the help of a local guide, found his way using a map.
Going to the countryside was a common occurrence in the past. Scholars didn't just study; they could also make their way in the world on foot.
He arrived at the village entrance. The road was still a dirt track, dry and stiff underfoot.
Several children were playing at the village entrance, looking at Zhao An with curiosity.
"Come on, Teacher Zhao, I'll take you to see the village head.
The terrain of Xiahe Village is too difficult to navigate; many teachers can't stay here.
Ah, it's truly a great thing that you've come."
The guide was an education bureau employee, also a local, familiar with the area; it was indeed very impoverished.
All he could see were mud houses; only a few cement houses stood out.
The road was blocked; things outside couldn't get in, and things inside couldn't get out—it was an unsolvable stalemate!
Zhao An smiled but didn't speak, carrying a large bag of luggage to the village chief's house.
The village chief's house was one of the few cement houses, and the village chief was a rather elderly middle-aged man.
"Village Chief Pang, this is the new teacher, Zhao An. He's a nationally renowned genius.
Don't mistreat him, or I won't let you off the hook. Haha!"
The director was clearly very familiar with the village chief; speaking to him in such a tone suggested an extraordinary relationship.
Seemingly remembering something, he added to Zhao An, "He's my cousin, haha, Teacher Zhao, please don't take offense."

chapters.title: Chapter 1246 remote and impoverished areas
paragraphs: "No, if it's convenient, could we have the children gather at the school?
I'd like to distribute the books to them. I brought some with me. This is my first time teaching, and thank you for giving me this opportunity."
Zhao An shook hands with Village Chief Pang, his smile bright and cheerful.
Village Chief Pang seemed somewhat flattered.
Zhao An possessed an extraordinary air, an intangible nobility combined with an approachable demeanor.
"Sure, sure, but I'm worried about the teacher working too hard. Teacher, would you like to rest for a while?"
Zhao An smiled and shook his head. "No rush. Let's distribute the books first and get to know the students.
Then we can have a good chat. Once we've done everything, we can have a proper drink.
I brought some wine. Brother Pang said you like to drink; we'll definitely have a good drink then."
He then took out several bottles of wine and handed them over.
"Oh dear, no, no, teacher, how can we take your things?"
Village Chief Pang genuinely seemed a little embarrassed, a very honest farmer.
If the village weren't so remote and poorly accessible by road, he wouldn't actually be qualified to be the village chief.
"It's alright, you'll have to keep nagging me in the future."
Zhao An smiled. What is the martial arts world?
The martial arts world is about interpersonal relationships, not fighting and killing, there's no such thing as domineering power, only shared interests.
If you can share common interests, then there's no problem that can't be solved.
Zhao An arrived at the school, which was just two rooms.
Xiaohe Village didn't have a large population, only about six hundred people, and the young people had all left to work and earn money elsewhere.
Only about three hundred people remained, scattered around.
There weren't many children in the school, only about twenty, some older and some younger, who hadn't attended school for a long time and had all stopped after a while.
Because the teacher couldn't take it anymore.
Zhao An remained calm. He introduced himself to the students and distributed textbooks.
"Come to class the day after tomorrow morning. Studying isn't for others, it's for yourselves. Studying can give you a better life.
If you don't study, you won't know how many convenient things there are.
It's like farming. In many places, tractors are used for plowing. One person can plow more than ten acres in a morning.
How much could be plowed by hand?
You know better than I do.
Alright, go back now. I'll bring you some extra reading materials later. Study hard, see you the day after tomorrow."
His words were few, simple, and concise. He said what needed to be said, and there was nothing more to say.
Children don't listen to grand theories; simple and easy to understand is better.
"From now on, you must listen to your teacher. If you don't, I'll tell your parents, understand?"
Village Chief Pang still held considerable authority. He had finally found a teacher, and he had to support him.
"Okay, goodbye, teacher."
The children answered timidly.
Zhao An waved his hand, then took out a cigarette and smoked it with Village Chief Pang.
"This is good cigarette."
Village Chief Pang took a deep breath. He rarely had the chance to smoke good cigarettes; he only got a little when he went to meetings in town.
"You'll get some more often in the future. Even the hardest times will pass."
Zhao An smiled.
"Oh, right, I haven't arranged a place for you to stay yet, teacher.
This place isn't big enough for anyone. Let me think."
Village Chief Pang thought for a moment, then suddenly remembered something. "That's right, you can stay at my sister's place. Come on, teacher, I'll take you there.
It's alright, my sister has another room available. Her son went out to work, leaving only her granddaughter and daughter-in-law at home."
Meanwhile, at the Henghui Club, several family members had gathered together.
"I heard Zhao An went to teach in the mountains. What's he up to?"
Huang Yu took a deep drag on his cigarette. Things weren't going well lately.
The cooperation with foreign capital wasn't going smoothly, mainly because market profits weren't high.
Moreover, the effects of lending were already showing—a terrible reputation, though the profits were still decent.
"Hey, who knows what he's up to? Damn it, real estate, finance, and stocks are all lucrative, but he didn't do those. Instead, he went into manufacturing!
He only makes a few hundred thousand a year, not even enough to fill a gap in his teeth."
Lin Xiao's tone was very displeased. Perhaps it was because his mother was pregnant, which would create another competitor for them, hence his annoyance.
Their father was still young, and now he also had to deal with his uncle's challenge. Maintaining his position as head of the family was already a struggle; he had no time to deal with anything else.
"Or, how about we go into manufacturing too?
Whatever he does, we'll do it. Who cares what it is? Let's just do it first! That kid never loses money!"
Fang Shunli's eyes were shrouded in smoke. Foreign trade had been tough lately; factories overseas were experiencing riots, and material prices were rising—it was difficult.
"We can't do it. He has a complete industrial system.
If he can't sell it all, he can recycle it himself. We can't handle that much on our own."
Huang Yu shook his head. His grandfather's sudden death was a major event in the Huang family.
This made him uneasy, as if he had a bad premonition.
"Damn it, forget it, let's not talk about him. If that beast isn't making money, are we not making money either?
Maybe he's just trying to lure us into manufacturing, and once we're distracted, he'll come back and devour us."
Lin Mo also said viciously. He had overheard his younger sister boasting to the women in the family, and he didn't know if it was just bragging.
The Lin family was also very unhappy with Lin Yuanyuan. A young lady from a respectable family becoming someone's mistress?
And to make matters worse, it was their future son-in-law who lost the deal. They had no leverage and could only grit their teeth and acquiesce.
Moreover, Lin Yuanyuan was already pregnant with her second child! Damn, she's incredibly fertile!
The scheming between large families...
Zhao An was fully aware of it all.
He didn't have time to engage in their intrigues. He could simply throw out some smokescreens, letting them continue to step on landmines, and one day he'd blow them to smithereens!
Regarding the money for a farmhouse, Village Chief Pang spoke to an older farmer's wife, who considered it for a moment and then agreed.
Zhao An took out five hundred yuan and placed it in the woman's hand. "Auntie, this money is for my food expenses. Please don't refuse.
This is one thing at a time. If you feel bad about it, just cook me some better dishes in the future."

chapters.title: Chapter 1247 Xiahe Village is too poor
paragraphs: Zhao An insisted repeatedly before the woman finally accepted the money.

Zhao An poured himself a glass of wine and sat on the kang (heated brick bed).

When it gets cold, you can burn firewood underneath to warm up, but it's a lot of work.
